fields.name: PPGDocumentUID
fields.title: Policy document identity
fields.description: Established stable DocumentUID shared by editions of the same policy. Leave blank until identity is evidenced; do not infer from title or filename.

fields.name: PPGPolicyEdition
fields.title: Policy edition (source stated)
fields.description: Edition/version printed in the source document. Distinct from SharePoint file Version; blank means not yet recorded.

fields.name: PPGCurrency
fields.title: Policy currency
fields.description: Blank means Unconfirmed. A newer capture/upload is not proof of current authority. Verified states require the supporting check and evidence.

fields.name: PPGReplacesEdition
fields.title: Replaces edition
fields.description: Link to the preserved earlier edition this document demonstrably replaces. Leave unresolved relationships blank.

fields.name: PPGAuthorityLink
fields.title: Authoritative source
fields.description: Canonical source used to verify this policy edition; a captured copy alone does not establish authority.

fields.name: PPGCurrencyChecked
fields.title: Currency checked on
fields.description: Date of the actual human currency verification, not the capture/upload date.

fields.name: PPGCurrencyEvidence
fields.title: Currency verification evidence
fields.description: Who checked, what version/source was checked, findings and evidence reference. Preserve earlier findings in native version history; do not infer approval.
